verdicts.reason: A keeps the original two-column layout with the right hierarchy (brand, headline, body, chips, big CTA) and only adds a little more space at the bottom. B shrinks 'Find It Near You' into a tiny pill jammed against the two badges, puts the GLACIER wordmark below the headline, and leaves a large dead area under the copy.

A shrinks the can into a minor element, runs the headline and body copy over the teal circle, and turns the CTA into a tiny pill with SUMMER ONLY orphaned on a second row. B is the faithful layout: clean columns, a dominant CTA and the product kept intact.
